welcome: QuestTogether's communication system has been rebuilt in preparation for WoW Forever's release. This major protocol change requires everyone to update together.

sections.title: Important: older versions cannot communicate
items: This release introduces a new communication protocol. QuestTogether 7.x cannot exchange player locations, quest progress, Party Quest Log data, or other addon messages with 6.x and earlier. Ask your questing partners to update too.

sections.title: Preparing for WoW Forever
items: We're making these larger, breaking changes now, ahead of WoW Forever's release, to put QuestTogether's communication system on a stronger foundation.

After WoW Forever launches, we'll take greater care to preserve backward compatibility between addon versions and avoid disruptive update requirements. If another protocol break becomes necessary, we'll communicate it clearly.

sections.title: Find players where you're looking
items: Player updates prioritize your current zone and a zone you keep open on the map, while more distant locations refresh in the background.
Nearby movement uses short, focused updates. Discovery requests are shared and staggered to reduce traffic in crowded areas.

sections.title: More reliable sharing
items: Quest updates, Party Quest Log transfers, player details, and diagnostics share paced delivery so large replies leave room for other activity.
Large replies can recover missing pieces without restarting the whole transfer. Delayed location updates retain their original age and cannot overwrite newer positions or withdrawals.
Location-sharing changes cancel queued public coordinates. On logout or a loading screen, QuestTogether attempts a final departure message; expiry remains the fallback.
